title: Recover a Hamming(7,4) single-error-correcting decoder
description: Reverse engineer a flattened, obfuscated gate-level netlist of a combinational Hamming(7,4) single-error-correcting decoder and re-implement it as clean, independently written RTL that is behaviorally identical to the reference for all 128 possible 7-bit codeword inputs.

interface.style: purely combinational, no clocks or internal state

evaluation.test_vectors: all 128 exhaustive values of codeword (7'b0000000 through 7'b1111111), each held for a #5 settling delay before sampling outputs

metrics.name: word_recovery_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of the 128 exhaustive input codewords for which data[3:0] exactly matches the reference decoder output.

metrics.name: structural_match_accuracy
metrics.description: Fraction of the 128 exhaustive input codewords for which corrected_codeword[6:0] and error_detected exactly match the reference decoder output, verifying correct syndrome computation and bit-flip correction.

metrics.name: functional_equivalence
metrics.description: Boolean pass/fail: 1 if all three outputs (data, corrected_codeword, error_detected) match the reference for all 128 input codewords under iverilog/vvp simulation, else 0.
